question: India's National Health Policy 2017 (NHP 2017) sets a target of raising government health expenditure to 2.5% of GDP by 2025.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. NHP 2017 set a benchmark of 2.5% of GDP for government health expenditure by 2025. This was a deliberate policy shift to increase the public financing of healthcare in India.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. NHP 2017 explicitly targets increasing public health spending to 2.5% of GDP by 2025, compared to the roughly 1.2–1.5% at the time of the policy — a significant commitment to health financing.
